steps.label: load_clean_closed_window_pre_signal_checkpoint

Verify effective userdir, same-run World/current turn, Safe mode Off, no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability, no pending input, unlit brazier and no prior site knowledge/signal/outing; saved baseline turn 5216234.

steps.label: ordinary_closed_window_smoke_only_regression
steps.objective: Use the normal lighter on the prepared indoor brazier in the clean closed-window copy. Prove actual fd_fire/fd_smoke and a smoke-attributed eligible camp admission before any light/contact source. Then follow same-ID scout/watch/return/report and natural night raid behavior, recording actor actions, targets, health and sourced damage. Historical ID7-attributed death remains evidence from its own run only.
proof_targets: 45/45 start-save hashes, effective userdir, same-run World/turn, immutable executable/path receipt, Safe Off and no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability
closed windows; clean pre-signal knowledge/contact/outing baseline; controlled camp geometry disclosed as setup
ordinary lighter ignition and real fd_fire/fd_smoke; separate smoke/light packet records and source attribution
smoke admission before any valid light/contact signal; exact camp/site/observer/weather/cap/LOS fields
same native actors through physical scout, three-OMT watch, return and delivered report
actual natural night raid pursuit/attack, actor action/target/health, damage source and terminal outcome if reached
fresh quicksave turns/payloads and simulation timing at meaningful transitions; exact process lifecycle and cleanup
invariants: No signal, contact, report, dispatch, hostile teleport, fire or light injection; no debug raider kill
Ordinary-view arm: both clairvoyance mutations, cloak and invulnerability remain absent
Do not call the controlled cannibal-site geometry natural generation or initial site knowledge
Maintain actual brazier fire through observed raid unless a concrete safety blocker requires stopping
Track all relevant actors by native ID/metadata and saved roster, including actors outside sight
At first harm use safe/stop observation; use ignore only deliberately for combat-through-outcome and preserve death attribution
Stop unchanged waits at the first material divergence; keep the first divergent save and transition handle

evidence_contract.claim: Fresh ordinary-view closed-window smoke-only regression on R020 from a byte-exact unlit pre-signal save; physical smoke must be the first admitted cause, followed by the native actor lifecycle and actual raid behavior where eligible.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Treat historical ID7 proof as separate. Credit this run only from its own signal, admission, actor and combat records; preserve first divergence and do not infer smoke-only from fire presence.
